rules: Every kernel call is budgeted (AbortSignal.timeout) and never throws — a hung kernel degrades to a short note, never stalls a turn.

Hot-path hooks (before_agent_start / context / input) use FTS-only search (/api/memory/fts-search, ~15ms) within hotPathBudgetMs. Never call the full /api/memory/search (~800ms vector+embed) on a hot path.
Side-effect writes on per-event hooks (audit log, memory store) are fire-and-forget — do not await them in the turn path.
Explicit user-invoked tools may use the full semantic search and defaultBudgetMs.
Normalize kernel response shapes at the adapter boundary so harness code never reads `data[].record` vs `data[]` differences.

hooks.session_start: Prime session: set name, status, inject TN system prompt + fast context.
hooks.before_agent_start: Inject fast FTS context into system prompt (hot-path, 400ms budget).
hooks.context: Per-turn: feed tool-suggestion monitor (fire-and-forget) + inject fast FTS context (hot-path).
hooks.tool_call: Enterprise RBAC enforcement (dangerous-pattern authorize) + fire-and-forget audit log.
hooks.tool_result: Auto-store substantial tool results to L2 (fire-and-forget).
hooks.session_before_compact: Enrich compaction summary with related L2 context.

compositionRules: Always start with RECALL (context_harvest / memory_search) before multi-step work.
Use DISCOVER (tool_search / tool_suggest) when hitting a capability gap.
Always end with PERSIST (memory_store) for non-obvious decisions/gotchas.
VERIFY (system_status) before and after production changes.

autonomousOrchestration.discovery: Read this manifest to enumerate capabilities across all bound harnesses.
autonomousOrchestration.dispatch: Each capability declares a uniform kernel binding; call the kernel directly regardless of harness, or call the harness-native tool name in `harness.<harness>`.
autonomousOrchestration.idempotence: memory_store writes are append-only; reads are side-effect-free. Safe to retry reads; batch writes.
autonomousOrchestration.budgets: Respect `budgetMs` per capability. Never exceed hotPathBudgetMs on turn-critical paths.
autonomousOrchestration.escalation: If a harness adapter is unavailable, fall back to the kernel binding (the kernel is the single source of truth).
